<!-- Author: Kunru Song -->

This report extracts the full-precision temporal, contemporaneous, and
between-person networks from the accepted S5.2 fit. It retains complete
unthresholded matrices, creates raw-p-thresholded sparse display matrices,
tests the prespecified Core-Peripheral temporal average-edge contrasts, and
exports the canonical edge workbook. It does not draw the networks or
calculate centrality. No FDR or other multiplicity correction is applied; the sparse display is therefore
exploratory and uses the unadjusted two-sided threshold `p < .05`.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
  collapse = FALSE, comment = NA
)

required_packages <- c(
  "bruceR", "dplyr", "knitr", "openxlsx", "readxl",
  "rmarkdown", "tibble", "tidyr"
)
available <- vapply(required_packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)
if (!all(available)) {
  stop("Missing required R packages: ", paste(names(available)[!available], collapse = ", "))
}

report_file <- knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)
report_directory <- if (length(report_file) == 1L && file.exists(report_file)) {
  dirname(normalizePath(report_file, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE))
} else getwd()
helper_candidates <- c(
  file.path(report_directory, "S5_0_mlVARHelpers.R"),
  file.path(getwd(), "S5_0_mlVARHelpers.R"),
  file.path(getwd(), "Step_5_mlVAR_Network_Analysis", "S5_0_mlVARHelpers.R"),
  file.path(dirname(getwd()), "Step_5_mlVAR_Network_Analysis", "S5_0_mlVARHelpers.R")
)
helper_file <- helper_candidates[file.exists(helper_candidates)][1L]
if (is.na(helper_file)) stop("Could not locate S5_0_mlVARHelpers.R")
source(helper_file, encoding = "UTF-8")

project_root <- locate_project_root(dirname(helper_file))
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = project_root)

data_file <- file.path(
  project_root, "Res_2_Data_for_Analysis", "dat_step5_mlvar.rda"
)
fit_file <- file.path(
  project_root, "Res_2_Data_for_Analysis", "fit_s5_2_primary_mlvar.rda"
)
result_file <- file.path(
  project_root, "Res_2_Data_for_Analysis", "results_s5_3_mlvar_networks.rda"
)
table_file <- file.path(
  project_root, "Res_3_Results", "Table_S5_3_mlVARNetworks.xlsx"
)

stopifnot(file.exists(data_file), file.exists(fit_file), file.exists(helper_file))
dir.create(dirname(result_file), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(dirname(table_file), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

# Load and validate accepted upstream objects

```{r load-upstream}
dat_step5_mlvar <- load_single_object(data_file, "dat_step5_mlvar")
fit_s5_2_primary_mlvar <- load_single_object(
  fit_file, "fit_s5_2_primary_mlvar"
)

fit <- fit_s5_2_primary_mlvar$model
node_map <- dat_step5_mlvar$node_map
node_names <- node_map$node

stopifnot(
  length(node_names) == 12L,
  inherits(fit, "mlVAR"),
  is.null(fit$output),
  all(fit_s5_2_primary_mlvar$fatal_gate$passed),
  identical(fit$input$vars, node_names),
  nrow(fit$data) == 16598L,
  length(fit_s5_2_primary_mlvar$fixed_effect_covariance$temporal) == 12L
)

input_audit <- data.frame(
  input = c("S5.1 data", "S5.2 fitted result"),
  file = c(
    "Res_2_Data_for_Analysis/dat_step5_mlvar.rda",
    "Res_2_Data_for_Analysis/fit_s5_2_primary_mlvar.rda"
  ),
  md5 = c(
    unname(tools::md5sum(data_file)), unname(tools::md5sum(fit_file))
  ),
  accepted = TRUE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
knitr::kable(input_audit)
```

# Full network matrices and edge tables

The directed temporal matrix is oriented as row = source at `t-1` and column =
target at `t`. The two undirected matrices contain symmetric partial
correlations and have structural zero diagonals.

```{r extract-full-networks}
raw_matrices <- extract_mlvar_matrices(fit)

full_matrices <- list(
  temporal = raw_matrices$temporal,
  contemporaneous = raw_matrices$contemporaneous,
  between = raw_matrices$between
)
diag(full_matrices$contemporaneous) <- 0
diag(full_matrices$between) <- 0

validate_network_matrix(full_matrices$temporal, node_names, symmetric = FALSE)
validate_network_matrix(full_matrices$contemporaneous, node_names, symmetric = TRUE)
validate_network_matrix(full_matrices$between, node_names, symmetric = TRUE)

temporal_edges <- edge_table_directed(
  full_matrices$temporal,
  raw_matrices$temporal_se,
  raw_matrices$temporal_p,
  node_map
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    network = "Temporal",
    family = ifelse(self_loop, "Autoregressive self-loops", "Cross-lagged edges"),
    supported_p05 = is.finite(p) & p < .05,
    sign = dplyr::case_when(
      estimate > 0 ~ "Positive", estimate < 0 ~ "Negative", TRUE ~ "Zero"
    ),
    edge_id = paste0(from, " -> ", to)
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(
    network, edge_id, from, to, from_label, to_label,
    from_community, to_community, from_subgroup, to_subgroup,
    estimate, se, ci_lower, ci_upper, p, supported_p05,
    self_loop, family, sign
  )

contemporaneous_edges <- edge_table_undirected(
  full_matrices$contemporaneous,
  raw_matrices$contemporaneous_gamma_p,
  node_map
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    network = "Contemporaneous",
    supported_p05 = is.finite(p_and) & p_and < .05,
    sign = dplyr::case_when(
      estimate > 0 ~ "Positive", estimate < 0 ~ "Negative", TRUE ~ "Zero"
    ),
    edge_id = paste(node1, "--", node2)
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(
    network, edge_id, node1, node2, node1_label, node2_label,
    node1_community, node2_community, node1_subgroup, node2_subgroup,
    estimate, p_node1_on_node2, p_node2_on_node1, p_and, p_or,
    supported_p05, sign
  )

between_edges <- edge_table_undirected(
  full_matrices$between,
  raw_matrices$between_gamma_p,
  node_map
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    network = "Between-person",
    supported_p05 = is.finite(p_and) & p_and < .05,
    sign = dplyr::case_when(
      estimate > 0 ~ "Positive", estimate < 0 ~ "Negative", TRUE ~ "Zero"
    ),
    edge_id = paste(node1, "--", node2)
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(
    network, edge_id, node1, node2, node1_label, node2_label,
    node1_community, node2_community, node1_subgroup, node2_subgroup,
    estimate, p_node1_on_node2, p_node2_on_node1, p_and, p_or,
    supported_p05, sign
  )

stopifnot(
  nrow(temporal_edges) == 144L,
  sum(temporal_edges$self_loop) == 12L,
  nrow(contemporaneous_edges) == 66L,
  nrow(between_edges) == 66L,
  all(is.finite(as.matrix(temporal_edges[c("estimate", "se", "p")]))),
  all(is.finite(as.matrix(contemporaneous_edges[c("estimate", "p_and")]))),
  all(is.finite(as.matrix(between_edges[c("estimate", "p_and")])))
)

knitr::kable(head(temporal_edges, 12), digits = 4)
knitr::kable(head(contemporaneous_edges, 12), digits = 4)
knitr::kable(head(between_edges, 12), digits = 4)
```

# Sparse inferential display matrices

The sparse matrices set unsupported edges to zero only for display and the
prespecified sparse-centrality sensitivity. They never replace the complete
unthresholded numerical result.

```{r sparse-matrices}
sparse_matrices <- lapply(full_matrices, function(x) {
  matrix(0, nrow(x), ncol(x), dimnames = dimnames(x))
})

for (row in seq_len(nrow(temporal_edges))) {
  edge <- temporal_edges[row, ]
  if (edge$supported_p05) {
    sparse_matrices$temporal[edge$from, edge$to] <- edge$estimate
  }
}
for (row in seq_len(nrow(contemporaneous_edges))) {
  edge <- contemporaneous_edges[row, ]
  if (edge$supported_p05) {
    sparse_matrices$contemporaneous[edge$node1, edge$node2] <- edge$estimate
    sparse_matrices$contemporaneous[edge$node2, edge$node1] <- edge$estimate
  }
}
for (row in seq_len(nrow(between_edges))) {
  edge <- between_edges[row, ]
  if (edge$supported_p05) {
    sparse_matrices$between[edge$node1, edge$node2] <- edge$estimate
    sparse_matrices$between[edge$node2, edge$node1] <- edge$estimate
  }
}

stopifnot(
  all(sparse_matrices$temporal[temporal_edges |>
    dplyr::filter(!supported_p05) |>
    dplyr::select(from, to) |>
    as.matrix()] == 0),
  isTRUE(all.equal(
    sparse_matrices$contemporaneous,
    t(sparse_matrices$contemporaneous), tolerance = 1e-12
  )),
  isTRUE(all.equal(
    sparse_matrices$between,
    t(sparse_matrices$between), tolerance = 1e-12
  ))
)
```

# Prespecified direct temporal contrasts

For every Distress-domain outcome, the contrast is the mean of the four Core
manifestation lag coefficients minus the mean of the two Peripheral
manifestation lag coefficients. For every Engagement outcome, the complementary
research-question contrast is mean Peripheral minus mean Core. Each contrast is
computed inside one outcome equation using its full fixed-effect covariance
matrix; significance is never inferred from separate edge p values.

```{r direct-contrasts}
contrast_for_outcome <- function(outcome, positive_nodes, negative_nodes, label) {
  submodel <- fit$model |>
    dplyr::filter(dep == outcome, type == "within")
  covariance <- fit_s5_2_primary_mlvar$fixed_effect_covariance$temporal[[outcome]]

  coefficient_map <- submodel |>
    dplyr::select(pred, predID)
  positive_ids <- coefficient_map$predID[match(positive_nodes, coefficient_map$pred)]
  negative_ids <- coefficient_map$predID[match(negative_nodes, coefficient_map$pred)]
  stopifnot(!anyNA(positive_ids), !anyNA(negative_ids))

  weights <- stats::setNames(rep(0, ncol(covariance)), colnames(covariance))
  weights[positive_ids] <- 1 / length(positive_ids)
  weights[negative_ids] <- -1 / length(negative_ids)

  estimate <- mean(full_matrices$temporal[positive_nodes, outcome]) -
    mean(full_matrices$temporal[negative_nodes, outcome])
  se <- sqrt(as.numeric(t(weights) %*% as.matrix(covariance) %*% weights))
  z <- estimate / se

  data.frame(
    outcome = outcome,
    contrast = label,
    positive_group = paste(positive_nodes, collapse = ", "),
    negative_group = paste(negative_nodes, collapse = ", "),
    estimate = estimate,
    se = se,
    z = z,
    p = 2 * stats::pnorm(-abs(z)),
    ci_lower = estimate - stats::qnorm(.975) * se,
    ci_upper = estimate + stats::qnorm(.975) * se,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

core_nodes <- paste0("PMU", 3:6)
peripheral_nodes <- paste0("PMU", 1:2)
distress_nodes <- c("DepressiveAffect", "Anxiety", "Stress")
engagement_nodes <- c("InteractiveLog", "ActiveLog", "PassiveLog")

planned_contrasts <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  lapply(distress_nodes, function(outcome) {
    contrast_for_outcome(
      outcome, core_nodes, peripheral_nodes,
      "Mean Core-to-Distress minus mean Peripheral-to-Distress"
    )
  }),
  lapply(engagement_nodes, function(outcome) {
    contrast_for_outcome(
      outcome, peripheral_nodes, core_nodes,
      "Mean Peripheral-to-Engagement minus mean Core-to-Engagement"
    )
  })
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    family = ifelse(outcome %in% distress_nodes, "Distress-domain contrasts", "Engagement contrasts"),
    supported_p05 = is.finite(p) & p < .05
  )

stopifnot(
  nrow(planned_contrasts) == 6L,
  all(is.finite(as.matrix(planned_contrasts[c("estimate", "se", "p")]))),
  all(planned_contrasts$se > 0)
)

knitr::kable(planned_contrasts, digits = 4)
```

# Network summaries

```{r summaries}
network_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  temporal_edges |>
    dplyr::group_by(network, family) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      possible_edges = dplyr::n(), supported_edges = sum(supported_p05),
      supported_positive = sum(supported_p05 & estimate > 0),
      supported_negative = sum(supported_p05 & estimate < 0),
      mean_absolute_weight = mean(abs(estimate)),
      maximum_absolute_weight = max(abs(estimate)), .groups = "drop"
    ),
  contemporaneous_edges |>
    dplyr::group_by(network) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      family = "Unique undirected edges", possible_edges = dplyr::n(),
      supported_edges = sum(supported_p05),
      supported_positive = sum(supported_p05 & estimate > 0),
      supported_negative = sum(supported_p05 & estimate < 0),
      mean_absolute_weight = mean(abs(estimate)),
      maximum_absolute_weight = max(abs(estimate)), .groups = "drop"
    ),
  between_edges |>
    dplyr::group_by(network) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      family = "Unique undirected edges", possible_edges = dplyr::n(),
      supported_edges = sum(supported_p05),
      supported_positive = sum(supported_p05 & estimate > 0),
      supported_negative = sum(supported_p05 & estimate < 0),
      mean_absolute_weight = mean(abs(estimate)),
      maximum_absolute_weight = max(abs(estimate)), .groups = "drop"
    )
)

stopifnot(
  sum(network_summary$possible_edges) == 276L,
  all(network_summary$supported_edges >= 0L),
  all(network_summary$supported_edges <= network_summary$possible_edges)
)
knitr::kable(network_summary, digits = 4)
```

# Save canonical results and export the workbook

```{r save-and-export}
provenance <- list(
  data_input = "Res_2_Data_for_Analysis/dat_step5_mlvar.rda",
  data_md5 = unname(tools::md5sum(data_file)),
  model_input = "Res_2_Data_for_Analysis/fit_s5_2_primary_mlvar.rda",
  model_md5 = unname(tools::md5sum(fit_file)),
  generating_script = "Step_5_mlVAR_Network_Analysis/S5_3_ExtractmlVARNetworks.Rmd",
  helper_md5 = unname(tools::md5sum(helper_file)),
  edge_rule = paste(
    "Temporal Wald p values; contemporaneous/between conservative AND p",
    "using max of the two node-wise p values; no multiplicity correction"
  ),
  sparse_rule = paste(
    "Unadjusted two-sided p < .05 display threshold; full matrices remain",
    "canonical; sparse display is exploratory"
  ),
  rounding_rule = "Workbook display rounded to four decimals; RDA retains full precision"
)

results_s5_3_mlvar_networks <- list(
  full_matrices = full_matrices,
  sparse_matrices = sparse_matrices,
  edge_tables = list(
    temporal = temporal_edges,
    contemporaneous = contemporaneous_edges,
    between = between_edges
  ),
  planned_contrasts = planned_contrasts,
  network_summary = network_summary,
  node_map = node_map,
  layout = dat_step5_mlvar$layout,
  input_audit = input_audit,
  provenance = provenance
)

save(results_s5_3_mlvar_networks, file = result_file, version = 2)
rm(results_s5_3_mlvar_networks)
results_s5_3_mlvar_networks <- load_single_object(
  result_file, "results_s5_3_mlvar_networks"
)

workbook_sheets <- list(
  Network_Summary = round_numeric_columns(network_summary),
  Planned_Contrasts = round_numeric_columns(planned_contrasts),
  Temporal_Edges = round_numeric_columns(temporal_edges),
  Contemporaneous_Edges = round_numeric_columns(contemporaneous_edges),
  Between_Edges = round_numeric_columns(between_edges),
  Node_Map = node_map |>
    dplyr::select(order, node, label, community, subgroup, source, scoring),
  Model_Diagnostics = round_numeric_columns(
    fit_s5_2_primary_mlvar$model_diagnostics
  )
)

bruceR::export(workbook_sheets, file = table_file, overwrite = TRUE)
style_and_sanitize_workbook(table_file, workbook_sheets)

sheet_names <- readxl::excel_sheets(table_file)
reloaded_sheets <- stats::setNames(
  lapply(sheet_names, function(sheet) {
    as.data.frame(readxl::read_excel(table_file, sheet = sheet))
  }),
  sheet_names
)

formula_errors <- sum(vapply(reloaded_sheets, function(data) {
  sum(vapply(data, function(column) {
    sum(grepl("^#(REF!|VALUE!|NAME\\?|DIV/0!|N/A)", as.character(column)))
  }, integer(1)))
}, integer(1)))

workbook_audit <- data.frame(
  file = "Res_3_Results/Table_S5_3_mlVARNetworks.xlsx",
  sheets = length(sheet_names),
  exact_sheet_names = identical(sheet_names, names(workbook_sheets)),
  formula_errors = formula_errors,
  bytes = file.info(table_file)$size,
  md5 = unname(tools::md5sum(table_file)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

stopifnot(
  identical(
    names(results_s5_3_mlvar_networks),
    c(
      "full_matrices", "sparse_matrices", "edge_tables",
      "planned_contrasts", "network_summary", "node_map", "layout",
      "input_audit", "provenance"
    )
  ),
  identical(sheet_names, names(workbook_sheets)),
  formula_errors == 0L,
  nrow(reloaded_sheets$Temporal_Edges) == 144L,
  nrow(reloaded_sheets$Contemporaneous_Edges) == 66L,
  nrow(reloaded_sheets$Between_Edges) == 66L,
  nrow(reloaded_sheets$Planned_Contrasts) == 6L
)

knitr::kable(workbook_audit)
```

```{r validate-network-results, include=FALSE}
s5_3_acceptance <- data.frame(
  criterion = c(
    "Full temporal matrix and 144 directed edges",
    "Full contemporaneous matrix and 66 unique edges",
    "Full between-person matrix and 66 unique edges",
    "Raw p-values with conservative AND rule for undirected edges",
    "Sparse display matrices preserve only unadjusted p < .05 edges",
    "Six direct planned contrasts use within-equation covariance",
    "Sole result RDA reload",
    "Excel workbook reload, exact sheets, and zero formula errors"
  ),
  passed = c(
    nrow(temporal_edges) == 144L && all(is.finite(full_matrices$temporal)),
    nrow(contemporaneous_edges) == 66L &&
      isTRUE(all.equal(full_matrices$contemporaneous, t(full_matrices$contemporaneous))),
    nrow(between_edges) == 66L &&
      isTRUE(all.equal(full_matrices$between, t(full_matrices$between))),
    all(contemporaneous_edges$p_and >= contemporaneous_edges$p_or) &&
      all(between_edges$p_and >= between_edges$p_or),
    all(sparse_matrices$temporal[temporal_edges |>
      dplyr::filter(!supported_p05) |>
      dplyr::select(from, to) |>
      as.matrix()] == 0),
    nrow(planned_contrasts) == 6L && all(planned_contrasts$se > 0),
    file.exists(result_file),
    workbook_audit$exact_sheet_names && workbook_audit$formula_errors == 0L
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

stopifnot(all(s5_3_acceptance$passed))
```
